claims.claim: Toy model / schematic: cell size, amount of root loss and timing are exaggerated, not to scale

caption:
Two resorptions that stop when the cause stops.

Surface: small injury to cementum/PDL, shallow lacunae, new cementum within weeks if no infection (review-level time frame). Usually invisible on a radiograph.
Pressure (ortho force, impacted tooth, cyst/tumor): active while the pressure lasts. Remove it and it arrests, not instantly and not always. Lost root length does not return.
The pulp is not the cause and tests normal: no root canal treatment.

Refs: Abbott & Lin 2022, Dent Traumatol; Fuss 2003, Dent Traumatol; Patel 2022, Int Endod J; Falahat 2008, Angle Orthod.
